content:
Jeremy was climbing on a chair to get the chocolate chips and marshmallows. I said "what are you doing up there? That's a baking shelf not a snack shelf". He said "Chloe always comes up here". I said "I wish you guys wouldn't". He said "you know you can tell us not to". 
That really hit me. I know Kate has been trying to get me to parent more but it never really clicked until Jeremy said that... I feel a bit dumb for admitting it but...
I know the majority of my stresses are oriented around Kate so maybe I'm not seeing clearly through her suggestions anymore. Or maybe it's something else but that's where my head is at right now.
